monthly_sequence.cadence: monthly — 1st of month built 07:00 EAT, Day 1 = 2nd of month
monthly_sequence.guide: Shadow_Operation_Playbook.pdf (Consulting.com Growth Operator training) — MAIN GUIDE

phases.warm_up: days 1-3 — attention and trust, no selling
phases.value_delivery: days 4-9 — teach and prove, seed the problem
phases.money_days: days 10-14 — open offer, answer objections, close

monthly_sequence.asset_gen: Higgsfield renders each slide in the page operation style — stickman character lock, 1080x1350 feed / 1080x1920 story
monthly_sequence.publish: R2 upload -> G4 once per cycle in /content -> Buffer (IG carousel + TikTok, gated)
monthly_sequence.follower_gate: removed 2026-10-31 — metrics qualify, not follower count
monthly_sequence.demand_test: 3-slide carousel in Stories only, read after 72h — 50+ comments GREEN, 25-49 AMBER, <25 RED hold
monthly_sequence.gate: DEMAND-TEST GATE (replaces follower count): run the 3-slide carousel in Stories, read at 72h — 50+ comments = PASS -> proceed with the full sequence immediately; 25-49 = AMBER -> warm up and retest; <25 = RED -> hold. Scans update the DB every cycle.

dual.green_fast_close: Comments→DM→Whop→Purchase same day via ChatFuel IG&TikTok + ManyChat YT — 3-email cap → FINAL TERMS 10pts (Hard Rule 2/3)
dual.amber_14day: Comments→DM→14-day→Whop→Purchase via ChatFuel IG&TikTok + ManyChat YT drip Day1-3 value proof, Day4-7 teardown, Day8-14 close + Whop $19/mo Circle — daily CTA (no FINAL TERMS), AMBER YES any day exits to fast-close
dual.priority: Comments→DM→Whop→Purchase prioritized over feed — both to advantage
dual.red_hold: ratio >70 or ER <3% HOLD — improve loop (see improve loop, no G4 per lock)

team.auth: Google OAuth via next-auth (only the 3 seeded emails may sign in) + email/password fallback; 6-digit 2FA required on /money and /admin; HMAC-SHA256 shadow_session cookie, edge middleware role gate
team.interview: 18 questions per seat (9 shared + 9 role) — each carries a 'why', min-length enforced, autosaves to Neon team_profiles; second-pass follow-ups can be added per seat
team.digest: WF12 weekly Mon 07:30 — completeness per seat; a seat under 60% does not get unsupervised authority

autonomy.rule: money never recommended above 40% (prepare + approve); publish stays 70% until 30 clean G4 approvals
autonomy.env: AUTONOMY_<LANE> overrides any lane, clamped to its floor

community_funding.model: self-funding — Circle carries tools first, then prizes, then annual fund, then reserve
community_funding.prize_rule: prize pool = max(0, circle revenue - tools), cap 750 — scales with members, never a fixed promise
community_funding.decide_from_data: final floor locked from 60 days of real churn + conversion data, not from a model

autopay.rule: Jarvis proposes only until the owner grants authority in /money; granting writes audit_log and starts next cycle, never retroactive
autopay.annual_resubscribe: annual renewal fund accumulates $133/mo, converts TubeGen/Higgsfield/Buffer/OpusClip to annual once funded
